item.title: SEC plans to propose crypto rules covering token offerings, broker-dealer custody, and trading venues as soon as July 2026.
MiCA's July 1 enforcement deadline displaced an estimated 10 million EU users as unlicensed exchanges halted services across the bloc.
EU regulators opened a MiCA review process, consulting on stablecoin interest-payment rules and DeFi classification gaps.
Three DeFi bridges lost $35 million in six hours on July 23: AFX Trade ($24.2M), Verus-ETH ($7.5M), and B2 Network ($3.9M).
DTCC and 50+ firms will pilot tokenized securities trading in July, with a full platform launch targeting October.
JPMorgan plans to accept Bitcoin and Ethereum as loan collateral, expected to unlock approximately $20 billion in institutional lending.
Circle faced criticism after $230 million in USDC was transferred via its bridge during a theft incident before the issuer froze the funds.
Ostium lost $18 million in USDC to an oracle manipulation attack on Arbitrum on July 15.
Researchers patched a critical Aptos vulnerability that could have exposed up to $70 billion in digital assets before exploitation.
BlackRock's ether ETF captured nearly all July U.S. spot ETH inflows as ether outperformed bitcoin by 11% on the week.
Kraken is pursuing a full European banking license in Lithuania to operate on traditional financial payment rails.
Sberbank, Russia's largest bank, plans to launch crypto trading infrastructure and a digital depository by December 1.
Europe's post-MiCA licensing standards are expected to drive consolidation as larger firms acquire unlicensed operators.
North Korea arrested hackers accused of laundering stolen domestic bank funds through cryptocurrency.
MiCA enforcement is expected to push smaller crypto apps to migrate user assets onto licensed custodian rails to retain EU market access.
